info.title: CPA Rust Gateway Management API
info.description: Contract-only management surface. It is not yet an HTTP listener; P10-02 owns authentication, network admission, CSRF/CORS, and Actix implementation.

200.description: One-time CPA or sub2api JSON export

get.description: Read-only bounded Prometheus text exposition of the background telemetry counters. Carries no request-scoped or target-scoped label.

ManagementKey.name: X-Management-Key
ManagementKey.description: Distinct from client inference keys; P10-02 defines validation and network admission.

ConfigVersion.name: X-Config-Version
ConfigVersion.description: Explicit draft or active configuration graph identity.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Opaque configuration revision token; a mismatch returns 409 without partial mutation.

OAuthOperation.description: OAuth operation status without token values

OAuthRefreshOperation.description: OAuth refresh result without token values

OperationalUsagePage.description: Secret-free durable usage and explicitly unpriced cost page

OperationalBillingPage.description: Secret-free immutable billing rows with status and known-cost summary
